On-device models: Apple built-in speech (no download), Parakeet v3 (25 European languages), Parakeet v2 (English), Whisper large-v3 turbo via WhisperKit; bring-your-own via Sarvam AI, Smallest AI or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (keys in macOS Keychain, no automatic cloud fallback). Cleanup styles: None (keep every word), Light (default, drops English ums/repeats/false starts, fully local), Medium (also edits for clarity via the notes model). Notes model options: Apple Intelligence, local Ollama, or a built-in Qwen3.5 2B download (1.28 GB, about 1.5 GB RAM, macOS 14, unloads after five idle minutes). Vocabulary learns corrections from History or immediately after paste; voice commands cover comma, question mark, new paragraph and scratch that. Meetings: Notetaker labels speakers Me vs Them, Calendar integration (off by default) supplies event title and invitees, long recordings cut at the quietest moment every 30-60s (measured 1,233 wrong words of 12,592 on three TED talks vs 1,282 whole-file); Ask answers cite transcript lines. MCP server via 'BetterWispr --mcp' (off by default, read-only) for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor. Media transcription accepts MP3/M4A/AAC/WAV/AIFF/CAF/FLAC/MP4/MOV/M4V or a video link via yt-dlp (installed only on click, checksum verified, YouTube best with Deno via 'brew install deno'); CLI BetterWisprCLI exposes --transcribe-file, --download-model, --media and --notes-model. Privacy: settings, vocabulary and history in ~/Library/Application Support/BetterWispr/workspace.json (not encrypted), audio written to temp files and deleted after each recording; Makefile ships an offline-test target that transcribes with networking denied. Release v0.1.5 (2026-10-12) ships BetterWispr-arm64.dmg and BetterWispr-x86_64.dmg (no Homebrew cask); changelog lists 0.1.6 (2026-10-15) with Codex subscription transcription. GitHub nyblnet/bento (TypeScript, MIT, 5,539 stars, 382 forks, 22 open issues, repo created 2026-07-17, last push 2026-10-21); latest release v1.2.9 published 2026-10-17 shipping Bento_Slides.bento.html; releases are cut locally by the maintainer so the signing key never leaves their machine, and updates are cryptographically signed. Agent integration via bento.page/agents.md (guide version 1.2.9) and the bento-slides skill (Claude Code plugin marketplace nyblnet/bento, SKILL.md zip for Claude.ai and Claude Desktop); works with Cowork, Codex, Gemini and ChatGPT projects, and with local models through Ollama, llama.cpp and LM Studio. Known trade-offs from the README: collaboration undo is snapshot-based and can revert a collaborator's concurrent edit to the same property, editing is desktop-first while phones view and present well, and large media must stay as hosted links because a 2-minute embedded video can produce a 100 MB file.
